en: Black-and-white panoramic view of a small European town along a river with a weir or low dam in the foreground. There are tree-lined paths, fields, and a park-like riverside area, with a compact town center beyond, including a church tower, residential houses, and an industrial complex with a tall smokestack. Rolling farmland and forested hills extend into the distance. In the bottom-left corner, white caption text reads "Wurzen a. d. Mulde".
